raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-AFW-HealthSecurityPhase3",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delay in recruiting required specialist staff (accountant, environmental, gender‑based violence, etc.) within the one‑month deadline.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop an accelerated recruitment plan, use temporary contracts, and monitor hiring milestones weekly.",
      "evidence": "CEMAC Financing Agreement: appoint, assign, or recruit an accountant, environmental specialist, gender‑based violence consultant not later than one month after Effective Date."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Failure to customize accounting software for the project within three months of effectiveness.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage an IT vendor before project start, allocate dedicated budget, and set clear deliverable dates with penalties for delay.",
      "evidence": "CEMAC Financing Agreement: customize existing accounting software no later than three months after the Effective Date."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Procurement delays caused by weak market competition and limited contract management capacity in fragile settings.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire experienced procurement specialists, conduct early market engagement, and adopt flexible procurement methods approved by the Bank.",
      "evidence": "Procurement Risks include delays, governance issues, weak contract management, and limited market competition in fragile settings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Inadequate stakeholder engagement leading to community opposition and project delays.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Umbrella Stakeholder Engagement Plan, hold early consultations, and maintain transparent grievance redress mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Potential social risks are substantial and relate to inadequate stakeholder engagement to properly inform design and implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA/SH) risks arising from the expanded community health workforce.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct GBV/SEA risk assessments, recruit a dedicated GBV specialist, and train all staff on SEA/SH protocols.",
      "evidence": "Overall project SEA/SH risks are substantial; increased presence of Community Health Workers may create concerns of sexual exploitation and abuse."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Political instability and conflict in Cameroon, CAR and Chad disrupting implementation and access to target areas.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Develop security risk assessments, flexible work plans, and contingency budgets; coordinate closely with UN/NGO security teams.",
      "evidence": "Fragility in AFW is exacerbated by conflict and violence, leading to large population displacements; Boko Haram attacks in Cameroon, unrest in CAR."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Climate‑related events (floods, extreme heat) damaging health facilities and laboratory infrastructure.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply green and resilient construction standards, elevate critical equipment, and incorporate climate‑risk assessments in design.",
      "evidence": "Climate change contributed to at least 50 % of natural disasters; floods raise risk of cholera; project includes green and resilient approaches."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Insufficient domestic financing after project completion threatening sustainability of health security gains.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Support development of medium‑term expenditure frameworks, track health‑security budgeting, and mobilize private‑sector partnerships.",
      "evidence": "Securing financial sustainability will be supported to integrate health security into national budgeting processes and domestic resource mobilization."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "High turnover or capacity gaps in Project Implementation Units (PIUs) leading to implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer retention incentives, clear terms of reference, and continuous capacity‑building programmes for PIU staff.",
      "evidence": "PIUs will be led by a dedicated coordinator; staff recruitment and capacity building are required for effective implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Laboratory biosafety incidents due to handling of high‑risk pathogens.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement strict biosafety and biosecurity SOPs, certify labs to international standards, and conduct regular training drills.",
      "evidence": "Laboratory Quality and Capacity subcomponent includes strengthening biosafety & biosecurity and establishing a quality management system."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Data interoperability failures across human, animal and environmental surveillance systems.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a common data standards framework, deploy interoperable digital platforms, and provide joint training for data managers.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 2.1 aims to integrate OH data using an interoperable digital platform and develop dashboards for decision‑making."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delay in establishing the Regional Coordination Committee (RCC) and formal MoUs with regional bodies.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set a firm deadline of 30 days post‑effective date for MoU signing and monitor progress through quarterly reports.",
      "evidence": "CEMAC Financing Agreement: establish collaboration measures with WAHO no later than thirty days after the Effective Date."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Weak monitoring and evaluation leading to poor visibility of results and corrective actions.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen M&E teams, adopt real‑time reporting tools, and conduct independent mid‑term evaluations.",
      "evidence": "PIUs are responsible for M&E of specific project activities and will report progress in accordance with the Results Framework."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Supply‑chain disruptions for medical countermeasures during an emergency response.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Pre‑position essential stockpiles, develop logistics contingency plans, and establish agreements with regional suppliers.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 3.1 includes strengthening emergency logistics and stockpiling to ensure access to countermeasures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Persistent gender gaps in epidemiology and veterinary training limiting workforce capacity.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set gender‑balanced training targets, conduct outreach to women candidates, and provide flexible learning formats.",
      "evidence": "HeSP‑3 aims to close the gender gap in technical roles; women currently under‑represented in epidemiology and veterinary fields."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Delays in meeting legal conditions of effectiveness (e.g., adoption of Project Operations Manual).",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Assign a legal compliance officer to track all conditions and submit required documents ahead of deadlines.",
      "evidence": "Effectiveness conditions require the Recipient to prepare and adopt the Project Operations Manual within specified timeframes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Bottlenecks in external audit procurement causing late financial reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Identify and pre‑qualify multiple audit firms, schedule audit timelines early, and maintain a backup auditor list.",
      "evidence": "Recipient must recruit an external auditor no later than six months after the Effective Date."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Resurgence of COVID‑19 or another pandemic disrupting training, travel and field activities.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop virtual training modules, enforce health safety protocols, and maintain flexible timelines for field work.",
      "evidence": "COVID‑19 pandemic exacerbated service delivery challenges; project includes digital platforms and remote training to mitigate such disruptions."
    }
  ]
}
